fineControlOnly: This delivery needs a technical decision. Use the detailed controls on the board.

headline.success: Your change is ready for review
headline.successMany: All {{count}} changes are ready for review
headline.failedPartial: Only part of this could be completed

confidence.tooltip: The AI reviewer's own score for its work — not an independent check.

accept.create-pr: Accept and open a pull request
accept.irreversibleWarning: This writes the changes directly into your project on your computer. There is no separate review copy and this cannot be undone.
accept.irreversibleConfirm: Yes, write it into my project

requestChanges.label: Ask for changes
requestChanges.comingSoon: Coming next: describe the change in one sentence.
requestChanges.placeholder: e.g. make the login button blue
requestChanges.hint: Quick SDD applies your change on the existing branch and updates this delivery.

discard.label: Throw this away
discard.stackedNote: Later rails of this milestone were built on this delivery. Discarding it pauses the milestone chain; the later rails keep their work.

watchOut.title: Worth a look before you accept

churn.batchNotSplittable: File changes are reported for the whole delivery, not per request.

app-verified.title: Measured by Specrails
app-verified.caveat: Facts taken from the actual changes.

ai-reported.title: Reported by the AI
ai-reported.caveat: The AI's own words. Specrails did not run these checks itself.

reviewer-score.title: AI reviewer's self-assessment
reviewer-score.caveat: The AI grading its own work — useful, but not an independent review.

proof.verificationPassed: The AI reported its checks passed ({{count}})
proof.verificationFailed: The AI reported its checks FAILED ({{count}})
proof.noVerificationReported: The AI did not report any verification.
proof.hostCommandPassed: The runtime ran {{label}} itself: exit code {{exitCode}} ({{seconds}}s)
proof.hostCommandFailed: The runtime ran {{label}} itself and it FAILED: exit code {{exitCode}} ({{seconds}}s)

watch.humanReviewRecommended: The AI reviewer scored this {{overall}}/100 and recommends a person look at it.
watch.lowConfidence: The AI reviewer scored this only {{overall}}/100.
watch.noTestsForChangedCode: {{files}} code files changed with no test changes.

error.notFound: This review could not be found.
error.loadFailed: The review could not be loaded.
error.actionFailed: That action did not go through.
error.revisionStale: This was just resolved elsewhere — reload to see where it stands.
error.revisionFailed: The change could not be started. Your text was kept.
error.revisionBudget: The daily budget is exhausted, so the change was not started. Your text was kept.

drift.title: This may have outgrown its original request
drift.advisory: Only a suggestion — you can keep asking for changes.
drift.costShare: {{revisions}} change(s) have cost {{revisionCost}} — {{share}}% of the {{originalCost}} original build.
drift.outOfScopeChurn: {{files}} of {{total}} changed files were never part of the original request.
drift.revisionCount: You've asked for {{revisions}} rounds of changes. Rewriting the request may be quicker.

planned.title: Planned approach (from the spec)
planned.caveat: What the request proposed — not a report of what the AI did. The facts above are what actually changed.

followUp.title: Review comments to resolve ({{count}})
followUp.caveat: What you asked the run to fix, frozen at launch. Verdicts below are the run’s own report — not a claim that everything is fine because the tests passed.
followUp.noReport: The run did not report this comment. Check the changes and evidence below.

addenda.title: Spec addenda this run was briefed with ({{count}})
addenda.caveat: Iteration notes attached to the spec and frozen at launch. Verdicts below are the run's own report — not a claim that everything is fine because the tests passed.
addenda.noReport: The run did not report this addendum. Check the changes and evidence below.

derivation.title: Derivation
derivation.coverage: {{explained}} of {{files}} changed files are explained by the derived design
derivation.caveat: Coverage is measured by Specrails from git; the confidence is the agent's own assessment.
derivation.unavailable: The derivation report of this Flow delivery could not be read. Review the diff directly.
derivation.rewriteFailed: The spec could not be rewritten from the derived change; it keeps its Flow draft. The OpenSpec change is still the technical record.

brief.title: What to look at
brief.caveat: The AI reviewer's advisory brief: where a human should look first. It is not a verification result and never blocks a decision.
brief.diagnostic: Part of the reviewer's brief could not be used:
brief.dropped_one: {{count}} brief entry did not match the expected format and was skipped.
brief.dropped_other: {{count}} brief entries did not match the expected format and were skipped.

agentActions.caveat: Recorded from the agents' own streams: reads are only as complete as each provider reports them. Contents and environment values are never stored.
agentActions.downloadFailed: Could not download the agent actions

requirements.title: Requirements demonstrated {{demonstrated}}/{{total}}
requirements.caveat: Measured by Specrails: a requirement counts when a test tagged with its id ran in a passing verification. Advisory; it does not change the review.
requirements.caveatNoReceipt: No verification receipt backs part of this trace, so those requirements cannot count as demonstrated yet.
requirements.untagged_one: {{count}} test tag matches no requirement ({{tags}}): a typo or a renamed requirement.
requirements.untagged_other: {{count}} test tags match no requirement ({{tags}}): typos or renamed requirements.

baseline.title: Spec created where the work passed

status.planned: Baseline planned: {{requirements}} as-built requirements, {{tests}} characterization tests
status.passed: Baseline proven on the unchanged code: {{requirements}} as-built requirements, {{tests}} characterization tests
status.failed: Baseline blocked: the characterization tests did not pass on the unchanged code, so the module was not edited
status.violated: Baseline blocked: the baseline step edited code other than tests, so the run stopped
status.not-needed: No baseline needed: specs already cover the code this change touches

baseline.cost: Baseline cost {{amount}} over {{turns}} turns, counted apart from the change
baseline.costUnknown: Baseline cost not reported by the provider
baseline.caveat: Characterization tests describe today's behaviour; Core ran them on the unchanged code before any edit.

humanEyes.caveat: Rules written for this project that no automated check can enforce. Check them yourself before accepting.
